implemented_behavior: Deterministic packet corpus (27 cases): IPv4/6, VLAN/QinQ, IPv6 ext headers, fragments (first/non-first/atomic), truncation, bad checksum, ICMP/PTB, abnormal TCP flag combos, SYN/ACK/FIN/RST probes, UDP, QUIC Initial/short-header
AF_PACKET sender with rate control + dual-end observer + pcap writer
